critique.evidence: Strong cyber-editorial identity, disciplined cyan/red palette, crisp borders, and clear desktop hierarchy. Tablet remains composed. Mobile degrades: the headline wraps into an oversized six-line block, the red evidence panel becomes narrow and text-heavy, and the stacked outcome cards create a long, cramped column. The global header is polished on desktop but visually incomplete at smaller widths: tablet/mobile navigation is clipped into a horizontal rail, mobile omits the brand name and red-mode action, and low-contrast microtype is difficult to scan. Contrast proof is also incomplete for 1 tablet and 12 mobile header nodes, so an 8 is not supported.
critique.fix: Reduce the mobile headline scale and vertical spacing; simplify or collapse evidence metadata; increase small-text size/contrast; give the red panel more usable inner width; and redesign the tablet/mobile header with an explicit compact navigation pattern that preserves branding, active location, and the red-mode action without clipped labels.
